notes: Source discovery, licensed field-recording selection, motion checks, thumbnails, copy and rendering all run in Cloud.
No paid API or personal computer is required. Only standard runners in this public repository may execute production.
Fresh source identities and hashes are retained in private annual history; earlier media is not silently recycled.
A failed source, quality check or transfer leaves the dated package blocked and visible as a failed workflow run.
YouTube upload and publication remain manual.
